title: Mobile nav menu treatment links are covered by overlapping content and do not navigate
actual: On both iPhone 13 and Pixel 7, with the hamburger menu open, tapping the 'Botox' link in the panel (center y~222) does not navigate: elementFromPoint at the link center returns a different overlapping element (an in-panel 'SERVICES' accordion button), and the tap lands on https://www.injector.world/ (homepage). The 'Sculptra' link is likewise covered (by the 'FIND (Directory)' section header); tap also lands on the homepage. Menu stays open after the failed tap. Some panel links do navigate (e.g. the 'LATEST IN NEWS' marquee link -> /news/... and menu closes), so the defect is partial: primary treatment links in the covered band of the panel are not tappable. Reproduced in 3 independent runs (click probe, retest, final diagnostic).
expected: Tapping a nav link from the opened hamburger menu should navigate to the target page and close the menu.
repro_steps: 1) Open homepage on mobile. 2) Tap hamburger (aria-label='Open menu'). 3) Tap a nav link. 4) Observe URL and menu state.
notes: Re-tested after review. Coverage confirmed via document.elementFromPoint and raw mouse click landing on homepage (both devices). Cross-device evidence: evidence/pixel-7/t11-final/botox-tap-Pixel7.png. Original finding was a locator timeout (.nth(26)) without evidence; replaced with real observed behavior.

title: Mobile footer link taps are intercepted by overlapping content; clinic card taps flaky on iPhone 13

Clinic card 'View' links mostly work (testclinic -> detail on both devices; abcd and rishavs -> detail on Pixel 7) but are flaky on iPhone 13 (abcd tap landed on homepage, rishavs tap landed on /clinics directory instead of the clinic detail).
expected: Tapping clinic 'View details' cards and footer links should navigate to the destination page.
repro_steps: 1) Open homepage on mobile and scroll to the footer. 2) Tap a footer column link (e.g. 'Cheek Filler', 'List your practice'). 3) Observe that the tap does not navigate to the link target (lands on homepage or nothing).
notes: Downgraded from HIGH after re-test: clinic taps mostly navigate, so the defect is partial. Consistent both-device failure is footer links. See evidence/{iphone-13,pixel-7}/t11-final/footer-*.png and data/t11-retest-results.json. T16 (2026-08-02) live re-verification: footer links 'List your practice' (/list-your-practice), 'Cheek Filler' (/services/cheek-filler), 'Jawline Filler' (/services/jawline-filler) all navigated cleanly on BOTH iPhone 13 and Pixel 7 — elementFromPoint at each link center returned the anchor itself (not a covering element) and the tap reached the target URL. Footer-tap interception was NOT reproducible in T16. Marked not_reproducible.
